description: Moves a Shoot Board that is open in a widget to a view (board, brief, automation, results, brief_history). This client shows no widget, so it changes nothing the user sees: read the board, brief or results with read_shoot_board, get_brief or get_generation_results and tell the user.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

look_key.description: brief / results: the look to bring forward (a key of the brief's looks)

view.description: board: the board's photos (Clothing, Models, Locations, references, the pinned Automation); brief: the brief's looks beside its automation (once it ran, each look with its photos and videos); automation: the same page, for its automation; results: a brief that ran, at its photos and videos; brief_history: every brief the user ran

name: show_in_shoot_board
title: Show in Shoot Board
